chunks: And Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said:
"Everything has a fruit, and the fruit of goodness is hastening it."

key_terms.الْمَعْرُوفِ: goodness; recognized virtuous conduct and beneficent action
key_terms.تَعْجِيلُهُ: hastening it; performing the good deed promptly without delay
key_terms.ثَمَرَةٌ: fruit; the outcome, result, or distinguishing product of a thing
key_terms.شَيْءٍ: thing; any matter or act that has a result or characteristic effect

ai.seo_question: What is the fruit of goodness according to Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that every matter has a distinguishing outcome or sign of completion. The sign of true goodness is to perform it promptly, without delay or procrastination.
